# replace program to horizontal only, verify demos concept
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row)-1):
            if row[c-1] == 8 and row[c+1] == 8:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
''')
# generic color differs task demos show 8 vs test 4; adjust detect foreground as non-background?  
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    fg = next((x for x in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if x != bg), None)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row)-1):
            if row[c-1] == fg and row[c+1] == fg and row[c] == bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
''')
out=__import__('runpy').run_path(str(p))['transform'](grid)
